name: Fix-It Desk
audience: Employees at a small business whose laptop, printer or Wi-Fi just stopped working and who need help fast
promise: Tell us what broke. We handle the rest.
headline: Something broke? We can help fix it.
summary: Fix-It Desk is a fast, simple way for small-business teams to get tech problems troubleshot without the jargon.
design_direction: One clear action, a short page with no unnecessary scrolling, and calm blues
